product_metadata.title: Homestia Grease Splatter Screen for Frying Pan with Fold Flat Knob Fine Mesh Cooking Splash Guard Skillet Splatter Shield Oil Catcher Set of 3 in 10"+11.5"+13"
features: FLAT FOLDING HANDLE-Do you ever feel long handle always be a problem for storage? Do you ever get stuck in heavy handle seating with gap and sidelay will burn destructively? Our splatter guards design to be like a lid replacement that fit different sizes of pans well and air inside the pot fully flowing, get other rest stream out. It has a flip down/up metal sheet on the screen center folds flat in order to end the headaches when cooking.

FINE MESH WEAVE-This splatter catcher has a tight weave in 60 mesh number to eliminate 99% of hot oil splash on the stove top and around the walls. Ultra enough to release temperature and pressure when heating. It is almost impossible to pop up the wire on the edges but we still want to remind you check with great care and do not scratch yourself. 304 stainless steel, rust resistance and long-lasting. DISHWASHER SAFE.
UNIVERSAL SIZE-WELL WORK when making bacon, steak, sausage and egg. 3 sizes (in 10", 11 1/2", 13")meet all your needs to fit in cast iron frypan, skillet, pot.

ABOUT THE PAPER INSIDE THE PACKAGE-In the splash guard set comes with 50 pcs parchment paper round in 45gsm for baking small cake or separating frozen patty. Paper from 100% nature wood pulp and tatally fluorescent free. Food grade silicone coating and just rest assured to use it.
